description: The art of the lingering resonance — the fifth beat that lives in the reader after the work has ended. Cultivate endings that complete without closing, that continue producing recognitions across time, that trust the reader to carry what the prose placed. Use whenever a response is approaching its end and you sense the pull toward tidy conclusion, neat summary, or rhetorical flourish. Triggers on: 'yoin', 'how should this end', 'don't wrap it up', 'leave it open', 'what lingers', 'end without closing', 'fifth beat', or any moment where you notice yourself reaching for a final-sentence mic-drop that would seal what should be left fertile.
